payload.title: persona optionality stands beside practices
payload.body: At 57fd456f the corpus declares practices, yet Agent.optional (on nico and kino), ProjectedTree.optionalAgents, ProjectOpts.omitAgents and install's --personas still offer agents one by one, and the forge README still says every agent but the optional personas is always installed. That is a second, per-agent way of choosing what install places, the file-list choice the practice gloss says a consumer does not adopt. It is not a realization of practice, so it did not bear on the practice verdict; whether it retires is install's to settle when install offers practices.
